flat.code-diff.help-title: What changes should I make to my code?
flat.code-diff.unchanged-help: Lines like this help you find the part of your code which needs changing. The number (to the left of the vertical divider) shows you which line it is, in the code as it is now.
flat.code-diff.deleted-help: Lines like this show you code you need to delete.
flat.code-diff.added-help: Lines like this show you code you need to add. You can click on the button to copy the lines of code ready for pasting.
flat.code-diff.spaces-help: Faint "<c>···</c>" at the start of a line show spaces — type these as normal space characters.
